items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I had an excellent arranger named Danny Mendelson

ctx.x: I had an excellent arranger named Danny Mendelson, a young white fellow from Newark, and he did quite a few of the current pop tunes that came out in those days, and he studied quite a bit of orchestration and some of the sounds of the band was largely responsible to Danny Mendelson.
Oh, beautiful; I didn't know him.
